verdict.rationale: Vue's first-party docs describe a 'truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization' [vue-docs-4]. Community users corroborate an ergonomic reactivity API for component state, effects and computed values [vue-comm-2]. One user complains that reactivity only tracks changes under certain conditions [vue-comm-14], which is a caveat rather than a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of dependency tracking that re-runs only dependent effects/render code, in-depth reactivity guide content in the pack, and hands-on corroboration of granular updates.
